reason: I already have my place near the station where they start my order when I walk in. An $8 cheesecake matcha I drink standing up at a subway exit isn't going to pull me away from that.
objection: Nowhere to sit. If I'm paying $8 for a fancy drink on a weekend I want a table, not a few seats squeezed into someone else's bar.
would_change_my_mind: A friend dragging me there on a weekend and it turning out to have a real place to sit and a drink that's genuinely good, not just pretty.
